caveats: The all-active 8K benchmark repeats seed locations and is a systems stress, not an initialization or quality recommendation.
The canonical SPA starts with 4096 active seeds and fills the hidden half through splitting by step 26100.
The benchmark measures the complete tiled optimizer step but excludes preview, validation, and UI scheduling.
Zero overflow is scene- and scale-dependent; the live Tile Overflow metric remains a required validity check.
A matched convergence run is still required to establish whether 8K capacity improves train or heldout image quality.
